description: A large multiple-choice/fill-in-the-blank grammar test covering all six CEFR levels (A1-C2). Each question tests understanding and correct usage of a specific grammar point.
instructions: For each question, choose the option that correctly completes the sentence according to standard English grammar.

scoring_guide.note: Score is calculated per level. A test-taker is considered to have reached a level if they answer at least 80% of that level's questions correctly, and all lower levels are also passed at 80%+.
